services.desc: The first impression of anything, including an RV resort, cannot be overestimated. The design of the RV campground plays a large part establishing the best RV resorts. Accordingly, one of the first things an RVer notices when pulling into an RV park is the space between the sites. A sense of space, air, light and some greenery makes a good first impression. Does the park include paved roads? Is there a concrete slab and some aesthetically pleasing landscaping at your site? A tree, some shrubbery and a neatly maintained plot of nice green grass would be great to wake up to and be in the middle of during days of relaxation.
